title: Expected Cost Savings for Government from Pursuit of Healthier SG Initiative
what_it_is: Expected Cost Savings for Government from Pursuit of Healthier SG Initiative

sections.label: Healthier SG policy focus
sections.summary: Healthier SG is the correct policy to reduce disease prevalence as the population ages, though budgetary estimates are premature.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Healthier SG is the correct policy to focus on to reduce the prevalence of diseases as our population ages.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: It is too early to give a robust budgetary estimate.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The work has just begun, and the focus now is to get everyone on board and making sure everyone understands and buys into the mission objective.

sections.label: Healthier SG financing model timing
sections.summary: The Ministry of Health will announce changes to the healthcare financing model when ready, as Healthier SG starts mid-year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: When does the Ministry of Health plan to move towards this new healthcare financing model under Healthier SG?

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Because Healther SG is coming up in the middle of the year, so some residents have asked: what are some of the costs involved.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We can address some of these issues as they come along.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And when we are ready, we can and will make the appropriate announcements of the changes that will impact these residents.
